messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Customer 'MeridianStorm' (dedicated pool ded-eu1-43, VPC tenant storm-meridian) p99 latency breach in eu-west-1. Current p99 = 2480ms (SLO 1200ms). Auto-escalation -> channel #incidents.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-324 assigned to sylvia (oncall). Escalation policy: high-latency-slo-breach.

sylvia: I'm on it. quick status: is this across the whole pool or single host? Anyone have telemetry?

rajiv: Looking. Cloud metrics show tail latency spike across 4/8 GPUs in ded-eu1-43, correlated with high KV-cache misses and queue depth rising.

marta: Confirmed ingress from storm-meridian tenant spiked ~3x at 09:12 UTC. Rate is sustained, not a short burst.

kevin: Putting initial hypothesis: noisy tenant causing hot-shard on a subset of model replicas -> increased GC/IO. Suggest immediate tenant isolation if we can route their traffic to backup pool.

liz: Preparing fallback routing. We have warm spare pool ded-eu3-02 with compatible model variant v2-quant. Can shift traffic at routing layer. ETA ~ 6m to flip gradual redirect.

samir: Pre-check: model variant compatibility ok, but quantized variant has slightly lower quality. Customer affected is enterprise; they prefer availability > fidelity for now.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: "Tenant isolation (dedicated pool)" recommended. Steps: 1) mark tenant read-only / throttle, 2) evict from hot pool, 3) reroute to warm spare, 4) monitor p99.

sylvia: Action plan: (1) throttle storm-meridian to 30% traffic, (2) evict noisy tenant processes from ded-eu1-43, (3) route remaining traffic to ded-eu3-02, (4) warm cache. Assign: rajiv (evict), liz (route), kevin (cache warm), marta (customer comms).

rajiv: Executing eviction now. Command: ```rictl pool evict-tenant --pool ded-eu1-43 --tenant storm-meridian --grace=30s --reason "p99 spike"```

(added :rocket:)

rajiv: Eviction started. Logs: ```[09:16:15Z] evict started for tenant=storm-meridian on nodes: gpu-eu1-12,gpu-eu1-13,gpu-eu1-14,gpu-eu1-15```

marta: Throttling rule applied at ingress: ```route-set storm-meridian throttle=30% scope=ded-eu1-43```

liz: Kicking off routing shift. Using canary steps: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% to ded-eu3-02. Command: ```ri-router shift --tenant storm-meridian --from ded-eu1-43 --to ded-eu3-02 --steps 10,30,60,100 --interval 120s```

kevin: Starting cache warmers on ded-eu3-02 for top prefixes and KV entries. Script: ```./warm_cache.sh --pool ded-eu3-02 --tenant storm-meridian --prefix-file top100_prompts.txt``` ETA ~4m.

sylvia: Monitoring p99 now. Current metrics: p95=540ms, p99=1980ms (down from 2480). Keep updates every 2m.

rajiv: Eviction complete on 4 nodes. Some in-flight requests aborted; we fed fallback via routing.

marta: Customer comm draft: "We've detected a high-tail latency event affecting your dedicated pool in eu-west-1. We're isolating the noisy workload and shifting traffic to a warm spare to restore performance. Expect progressive improvement over the next ~10 minutes. We'll follow up with RCA and mitigation steps." Approve?

samir: Approve. Add note about potential brief degradations during cutover.

kevin: Cache warm complete. Warm stats: KV hit went from 12% -> 78% on ded-eu3-02 for warmed keys.

sylvia: Routing at 60% to ded-eu3-02. Current p99=1150ms. Still slightly above SLO but trending down.

liz: Pushing to 100% now. Command executed. ```ri-router status --tenant storm-meridian``` shows routeWeights: ded-eu1-43=0%, ded-eu3-02=100%

(added :white_check_mark:)

rajiv: Observability: KV cache miss rate on ded-eu1-43 fell to baseline. Queue depth normalized. No other tenants impacted.

marta: Sent customer update at 09:29 UTC: "We've shifted your traffic to a warm spare and isolated the noisy tenant. Performance is improving; our engineers continue to monitor. We'll schedule a post-incident call if you'd like rolling mitigations."

sylvia: Passing on-call to rajiv for 30m observation window. I'm leaving channel but will rejoin if escalations. (handoff)

rajiv: I have the handoff. I'll watch p99 for 30m and follow up with RCA outline. Quick checklist post-mitigation: - confirm eviction persisted, - snapshot metrics, - collect tenant traces, - prepare mitigation options (rate caps, dynamic partitioning, better cache priming).

kevin: Noted: file an action to add soft tenant backpressure if a single tenant exceeds X tokens/sec for >2m. I'll open a ticket.

marta: Customer follow-up planned: 30m update + invite to RCA.

ops-runbook-bot: Incident log: type=dedicated-pool-p99, customer=MeridianStorm, duration=~17m (start 09:12 UTC, mitigated 09:29 UTC). Primary mitigation: tenant isolation + traffic routing to warm spare.

sylvia: Thanks team. Closing war-room active phase. Leave thread open for RCA notes. :thumbsup:

(added :tada: by marta)
